name: Name Day
bio: Archetype: Ultimate Buff, Dispel. ⌽ Gains Moxie whenever the ally in front uses their Ult. ⌽ Applies [Ceremonious] to the ally in front after taking action. ⌽ Ult boosts DMG Bonus for Ults for the team and allows the ally in front to use Ult without consuming AP. ⌽ Skill 1 can dispel [Counter] status.
